scope: Source-only triage after the two failed weighted-Q6 precision revisions; no builds, local performance measurements or integrations for these proposals

candidates.head: 2988b0cefac8646c2c831a148aa4f2e947b5327f
candidates.title: Fused backend sampling penalties
candidates.decision: Do not benchmark for the current recipe
candidates.reason: Requires backend sampling and enabled penalties; the fixed U1 benchmark recipe does not enable backend sampling. The author reports a fixed roughly 22 microseconds per token saving with penalties, not a demonstrated benefit for this MTP workload.

candidates.head: 3c2537549283ca08a70301675d4a4f75dd5e2071
candidates.title: Native q8_0 KV in the flash-attention tile kernel
candidates.decision: Not applicable to this Blackwell target's dispatch
candidates.reason: The changed VEC-to-TILE decision is in the generic fallback after the Turing-MMA branch. For this model's head size 256 on sm_121, the earlier branch already returns VEC or MMA_F16. Its reported ROCm/gfx1151 gains cannot be transferred to this path.
source_evidence: PR diff changes generic fallback around lines 710-718 and TILE-only scratch allocation

candidates.head: 9e37a8578f47936fb7f89cbb45f4e98affc134a9
candidates.title: Vectorized MMQ activation tile copy
candidates.decision: Defer behind independent low-cost runtime hypotheses
candidates.reason: A plausible prefill-only change, not a decode optimization. The author reports roughly 1.1-3.1% gains on other models and an RTX 4090; the comparable 27B case is 2.4-2.6%. This is not a local failure result and does not establish an upper bound on this device.
